objects.taxonomy_description: Small Old World monkey measuring 30-60 cm body length weighing 2-8 kg. Body covered with long hair around face forming distinctive facial ruff. objects.taxonomy_description: Uncastrated adult male sheep measuring 65-110 cm at withers weighing 35-180 kg. Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black. Head broad with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds). Horns thick and ridged. Eyes dark with horizontal rectangular pupils. Ears lateral and drooping. Neck thick and muscular. Body compact and stocky. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail short. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, wool insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Secondary sexual characteristics include larger size and prominent horns.
